adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from a single `.find(...)` to `.filter(...)` and then iterated (`for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`). The recurring-cancellation branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)`) is now inside that per-reference loop, but it already iterates *all* `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith("_calendar"))` and then *all* `updatedBookings`, pushing deletes for each. This means if there are N calendar references, the recurring deletion work is repeated N times, duplicating delete calls. Additionally, within that inner loop it still uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, so only the first calendar reference per updated booking is handled, not all references.
